# Schemes of Work

> Free online Schemes of Work generator for Kenyan teachers to create customized curriculum plans by grade, subject, and term.

Schemes of Work is an educational planning platform designed specifically for Kenyan teachers. It provides both a generator tool for creating custom schemes of work and ready-made templates across multiple grades and subjects for the 2026 academic year.

## Key Topics

- Schemes of Work
- Curriculum Planning
- Educational Planning Tool
- Scheme of Work Generator
- Teacher Dashboard
- Grade Levels
- Subject-Specific Planning
- Term Planning
- Lesson Scheduling
- PDF Download
- 2026 Academic Year
- Mathematics
- Science & Technology
- English
- Chemistry

## Core Tools & Features

- [Schemes of Work Generator](https://schemesofwork.com): Free online tool for creating customized Schemes of Work for Kenyan teachers with curriculum planning and lesson scheduling features.

## Ready-Made Templates

- [Ready Schemes 2026](https://schemesofwork.com/schemes-of-work-2026): Pre-built Schemes of Work templates organized by grade and subject for the 2026 academic year, ready for download and customization.
